strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal-use weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux ↔ Linux or Windows with UDP/datagram-like earliest-complete inner delivery over WBD-owned TCP-shaped FakeTCP, a conservative release operating point on a physical link at or below 100 Mbit/s, shared username/password admission for multiple independent LiveID sessions, OpenWrt TPROXY capture with full-cone UDP behavior, and Windows TUN/Wintun-class capture.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2.2 transport/session semantics remain protocol-frozen at the qualified 40 Mbit/s aggregate-inner operating point. The OpenWrt platform adapter is now qualified independently of the WBD transport for both UDP and TCP: UDP uses endpoint-independent full-cone mapping/filtering keyed by the intercepted source endpoint with per-LiveID server isolation, and TCP uses adapter-owned WBDP byte offsets/cumulative ACK/retransmission above the frozen WBD datagram link. Root network-namespace gates pass real nft TPROXY capture, original-destination recovery, transparent return, full-cone EIM/EIF, underlay escape and cleanup. The next missing release slice is one actual OpenWrt one-shot that inserts the already-qualified Reality-front -> WBD FakeTCP -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK path between the platform client and platform server, then proves real DNS/UDP/TCP before moving to Windows.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not reopen FEC, FakeTCP, DTLS, Reality-front, ticket/LiveID, association fan-out, one-lane semantics or the 40 Mbit/s release operating point for platform convenience. Preserve earliest-complete WBD datagram delivery. Full-cone UDP is a platform mapping/filtering property; TCP application reliability remains only in the WBDP platform adapter. Do not import Xray/VLESS/Vision stream semantics into WBD.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed and root-qualified the OpenWrt platform layer through be3174a2cab0b032662dafda545c887c557d95f1. Full-cone UDP was reimplemented from behavior rather than copied source: the client maps one intercepted source addr:port to one FlowID across destinations; the server keeps one unconnected AF-specific UDP mapping socket per (wbd-link-server-mux service peer, FlowID); outbound packets may target multiple remotes and inbound packets from previously unseen remotes are accepted and returned with their real remote source in WBDP Peer. This provides endpoint-independent mapping and endpoint-independent filtering while preserving LiveID isolation. The root UDP gate logs WBD_OPENWRT_UDP_FULLCONE_EIM_PASS, WBD_OPENWRT_UDP_FULLCONE_EIF_PASS, TPROXY capture, underlay escape and cleanup. Added a single service-socket UDP/TCP dispatcher behind wbd-link-server-mux, a bounded per-flow TCP reliability machine, server TCP relay keyed by (service peer, FlowID), Linux IP_TRANSPARENT TCP listener/original-destination recovery, client TCPOpen/DATA/ACK/CLOSE handling with explicit OPEN ACK gating and bounded retransmission, and a root TCP TPROXY gate. GitHub Actions on be3174a2cab0b032662dafda545c887c557d95f1: ci run 32929706487 SUCCESS with Go tests and Handoff tests; openwrt-udp-tproxy run 32929706403 SUCCESS; openwrt-tcp-tproxy run 32929706457 SUCCESS; handoff-verify run 32929706491 SUCCESS. The UDP/TCP platform gates deliberately connect platform client/server through the local WBDP service path and therefore do not claim the final Reality/FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK release one-shot. Hairpin/NAT loopback is not separately qualified by these EIM/EIF gates.
continuation_cursor.current_task: Compose and qualify the actual frozen-WBD OpenWrt one-shot. Reuse the existing fullstack-mux-two-client startup sequence and pinned DTLS asset: Reality-like front issues a one-time ticket, one raw WBD FakeTCP association carries a pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 worker, wbd-link-proxy establishes the immutable LINK, and wbd-link-server-mux targets wbd-platform-proxy-server. Install scripts/openwrt_tproxy.sh only after the underlay/front/raw endpoints are explicitly escaped.
continuation_cursor.why_now: The separate OpenWrt UDP and TCP platform gates are clean, including full-cone EIM/EIF, and the existing transport/fullstack gates already qualify the frozen WBD association stack. The only meaningful remaining OpenWrt release risk is composition: making TPROXY capture coexist with the underlay escape while the platform datagrams cross the real Reality/FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK path exactly once.
continuation_cursor.done_when: One clean root/network-namespace OpenWrt attempt starts from no WBD nft/policy state, starts the pinned Reality/FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK server and client path, applies TPROXY with explicit underlay escape, then passes real DNS-style UDP request/response, general UDP request/response, and real TCP request/response through cmd/wbd-platform-proxy-openwrt -> wbd-link-proxy -> FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK -> wbd-link-server-mux -> wbd-platform-proxy-server. The test must prove underlay/front/raw traffic is not recursively captured and must cleanly restore nft/policy routing afterward. Keep the existing separate full-cone EIM/EIF root gate authoritative; optionally repeat EIM/EIF through the frozen WBD one-shot if composition cost is small, but do not require a new transport semantic. Then advance to Windows TUN/Wintun-class integration.

product_policy.link_setup: Reality-like TLS front is setup/admission only; sustained payload remains WBD FakeTCP -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable WBD link data.
product_policy.fec: Association setup admits off or fixed systematic 20:20 on the current live codec. No platform-triggered in-place FEC changes.
product_policy.accounts: One shared username/password may authenticate multiple simultaneous devices; routing/FEC/platform service state remains LiveID/peer/FlowID isolated, never username keyed.
product_policy.recovery: FakeTCP product default remains legacy shadow recovery; sack-rack remains experimental.
product_policy.routing: OpenWrt final capture is TCP/UDP TPROXY plus policy routing and mandatory underlay escape. UDP full-cone EIM/EIF and transparent TCP are platform-qualified. Windows final capture remains TUN/Wintun-class with endpoint escape.
product_policy.fullcone_nat: OpenWrt UDP platform semantics are endpoint-independent mapping plus endpoint-independent filtering: one internal source addr:port keeps one mapping/FlowID across remote destinations and a mapped socket accepts replies from previously unseen remotes in the same address family. This was behaviorally aligned with the mature Xray TUN full-cone source-only mapping pattern but reimplemented in WBD code. Hairpin/NAT loopback remains a separate optional qualification and is not implied by EIM/EIF.
product_policy.release_gate: Protocol is frozen by ADR-0010. Remaining release gates are one actual clean OpenWrt TPROXY -> Reality/FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK -> real DNS/TCP/UDP -> cleanup success, then one clean Windows TUN/Wintun-class one-shot.
